howto.name: Upload HEIC images
howto.text: Drop one or many .heic / .heif files (e.g. from iPhone photos).

howto.name: Choose page size
howto.text: Letter or A4. Each HEIC is decoded via libheif and scaled to fit.

howto.name: Download the PDF
howto.text: All images become one PDF, one photo per page. EXIF metadata is stripped by default.

faq.q: Will the PDF be much larger than the HEIC?
faq.a: Yes — HEIC is more efficient than JPEG. The PDF uses JPEG internally and is typically 2-3x the size of the source HEICs.
Default JPEG quality is 90, which is visually indistinguishable. Lossless would require PNG-to-PDF and produce much larger files.
